freshness.note: Observation dates survive failed refreshes. Browser also checks age at read time.

power_history.label: Miner power proxy: US industrial index × Cambridge survey anchor
power_history.method: 0.045 × EIA industrial USD/kWh / June-2024 EIA industrial USD/kWh
power_history.release_lag_assumption: EIA period plus two months; revisions are not vintage controlled.
power_history.limitations: Retrospective US-indexed proxy, not observed global miner tariffs. Cambridge median is not a hashrate-weighted mean. Historical backtests must not treat the later survey anchor as known in advance.

presentation.near_term: Supply economics through the estimated 2028 halving
presentation.long_term: Demand scenarios through 2033, with production-cost support visible

disclaimer: Context only. Not a trade signal. Not in base IRR.
source_commentary: Horizon Kinetics Q2 2026 Commentary pp. 32–36; Q3 2026 Commentary pp. 5–6

hk_reference.interpretation: Q2 calls $117k–$149k current SOTA plus 25% return; Q3 uses the same endpoints for April 2028. Timing/basis reconciliation is unresolved. Preserve both vintages.

amzn.note: Kept for research; not shown on dashboard panel.

diagnostics.default_policy: Existing constrained fit retained; free fit is diagnostic, not automatically promoted.

hk_anchor_implied.note: Illustrative calculation combining Q2 demand and Q3 approximate-year references from different vintages; not HK's equation. No fitted curve is attributed to HK.

demand.interpretation: Our constrained historical fit and free-fit diagnostic are independent of HK's published references. Exponent bounds are assumptions, not evidence of network adoption.

assumptions.note: Reconstructed path uses ASIC vintage mix (Hauck). CBECI TWh/J/TH is stored as a comparison series. $0.05/kWh is the HK-comparable miner power case. Halving step curve is the HK commentary marker, not reconstructed history. Forward fan is mixed_base; naive 2x is a labeled scenario.

naive_hk.assumption: Piecewise-linear watts/power-price scenario; subsidy changes discretely at estimated halving dates. No forced price floor.

efficiency_deflation.assumption: Piecewise-linear watts/power-price scenario; subsidy changes discretely at estimated halving dates. No forced price floor.

power_inflation.assumption: Piecewise-linear watts/power-price scenario; subsidy changes discretely at estimated halving dates. No forced price floor.

mixed_base.assumption: Piecewise-linear watts/power-price scenario; subsidy changes discretely at estimated halving dates. No forced price floor.

energy_overlay.note: Separate conditional mining-cost sensitivity on the World Model tab.

rig_comparison.method: Explicit capital schedule: electricity + ancillary cash opex + straight-line depreciation + 25% annual return on installed capital. No depreciation double count through the legacy 60% electricity gross-up.
rig_comparison.reconciliation: Compare with Q2 current $117k–$149k; Q3 reuses those endpoints at April 2028. Neither rig identities nor full capital schedules are published. Remaining differences are not calibrated away.
rig_comparison.fleet_limitation: Historical fleet weights are a hashrate-at-release survival proxy, not measured shipments. Compare Cambridge and 3/5/7-year survival sensitivities; adding catalog models is not evidence of market share.

electricity_history.label: Miner power proxy: US industrial index × Cambridge survey anchor
electricity_history.method: 0.045 × EIA industrial USD/kWh / June-2024 EIA industrial USD/kWh
electricity_history.release_lag_assumption: EIA period plus two months; revisions are not vintage controlled.
electricity_history.limitations: Retrospective US-indexed proxy, not observed global miner tariffs. Cambridge median is not a hashrate-weighted mean. Historical backtests must not treat the later survey anchor as known in advance.

fees.historical_data_note: Current mined-block download is observed. Older committed history may include projected mempool estimates; no historical fee backtest is claimed.
fees.assumptions: 144 blocks/day. Latest BTC fee rate held constant is a scenario, not a forecast; high case assumes 0.25 BTC/block. Future security revenue uses our constrained demand price, not HK's target. Missing fees are not labeled observed zero.
fees.issuance_note: Fees transfer existing BTC. Production cost per issued coin is distinct from fee-adjusted revenue breakeven.

supply.dynamic_support_note: Production cost is dynamic economic support, not a guaranteed price floor. Miner shutdowns and difficulty adjustment can change costs; raw demand paths are never clamped to supply cost.

sensitivities.note: Sensitivities at today's hashrate and subsidy. Do not use US residential electricity. Context only.

miner_stance.label: above_fleet_floor_below_sota_roic
miner_stance.plain_english: Average fleet is cash-profitable at this spot. New state-of-the-art machines with a 25 percent ROIC hurdle are not earning that return.

criticality.claim: Log-periodic ensemble on the same spot series as the power-law demand path. A smooth power law and a log-periodic acceleration are different descriptions.
criticality.interpretation: Qualified negative-bubble fits dominate the current ensemble.
criticality.policy: The critical-time range describes regime instability, not a promised crash or reversal date.

tail.label: The latest daily move is inside the historical tail.

dial.label: on_schedule
dial.plain_english: Near our constrained demand scenario. This is context, not forecast validation.

calibration_notes.note: Demand fit uses Yahoo BTC-USD plus pre-Yahoo seed/blockchain backfill. Origin 2011-01-01. Supply is Hauck/CBECI reconstructed all-in; HK $65k/$130k/$225k are commentary markers only. Demand k is unchanged.
